# 1 Enoch Chapter 91 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** And now, my son Methuselah, summon all your brothers to me and gather all the sons of your mother, for the word calls me and the spirit is poured out upon me, that I may show you everything that shall befall you forever.

**2** Then Methuselah went and summoned all his brothers to him and assembled his kin.

**3** And Enoch spoke to all the children of righteousness and said: "Hear, sons of Enoch, every word of your father, and listen rightly to the voice of my mouth. For I exhort you and say to you, beloved: Love uprightness and walk in it.

**4** Do not approach uprightness with a divided heart, and do not associate with the double-minded. Walk in righteousness, my sons, and it shall guide you on good paths, and righteousness shall be your companion.

**5** For I know that violence must increase upon the earth, and a great punishment shall be carried out upon the earth, and all unrighteousness shall come to an end; yes, it shall be cut off from its roots, and its whole edifice shall pass away.

**6** And iniquity shall again be consummated upon the earth, and all deeds of iniquity, violence, and transgression shall prevail in a twofold degree.

**7** And when sin and unrighteousness and blasphemy and violence increase in every kind of deed, and apostasy, transgression, and impurity increase — a great punishment shall come from heaven upon all these, and the holy Lord shall come forth in wrath and punishment to execute judgment upon the earth.

**8** In those days violence shall be cut off from its roots, and the roots of unrighteousness together with deceit shall be destroyed from under heaven.

**9** And all the idols of the nations shall be abandoned, and their temples burned with fire; they shall be removed from all the earth, and the nations shall worship them no more.

**10** And the righteous man shall arise from sleep, and wisdom shall arise and be given to him.

**11** And after that the roots of unrighteousness shall be cut off, and sinners shall be destroyed by the sword — cut off from the blasphemers in every place — and those who plan violence and those who commit blasphemy shall perish by the sword.

**12** And after that there shall be another week, the eighth, that of righteousness; and a sword shall be given to it that righteous judgment may be executed upon the oppressors, and sinners shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous.

**13** And at its close they shall acquire houses through their righteousness, and a house shall be built for the Great King in glory forevermore.

**14** And after that, in the ninth week, righteous judgment shall be revealed to the whole world, and all the works of the godless shall vanish from all the earth; the world shall be written down for destruction, and all humanity shall look to the path of uprightness.

**15** And after this, in the tenth week, in the seventh part, the great eternal judgment shall take place, in which He will execute vengeance among the angels.

**16** And the first heaven shall depart and pass away, and a new heaven shall appear, and all the powers of the heavens shall give sevenfold light.

**17** And after that there shall be many weeks without number forever, and all shall be in goodness and righteousness, and sin shall no more be mentioned forever."

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 91 frames the Epistle of Enoch (chs. 91–108) as a testamentary address to Enoch's family. Verses 12–17 constitute the second half of the Apocalypse of Weeks; the first half (weeks 1–7) appears in 93:1–10, with the present passage following in the original sequence (restored by Charles and others). The "great eternal judgment" (v. 15) echoes themes from the Book of the Watchers.*
